name: Face Time
source:
Face Time is a game about a masquerade party. The character has just been dumped after a long-term relationship and he’s invited to a formal dress masquerade party by his friend in order to help him get over his lingering feelings.

[From Gamers With Jobs]

Released as part of the [url=http://noyb.retroremakes.com/Games/tsoc.html]Masquerade experiment[/url].
translation:
《Face Time》是一款以假面舞会为主题的游戏。
主角刚结束一段长期感情，朋友为了帮他摆脱挥之不去的情绪，邀请他参加一场穿正式礼服的假面舞会。

[摘自Gamers With Jobs]

作为[url=http://noyb.retroremakes.com/Games/tsoc.html]假面实验[/url]的一部分发行。
